content: Kanani kwieyari mata'atɨkatsie
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«'Ixaheritsixi memɨtemaikakɨ mɨpaɨ ketiniwarutahɨawi Kanani kwieyari hakewa meuye'atɨka, kwie xehetsiemieme mayani, mana kaniuye'atɨkani:
»Tahetɨa manuye'atɨkatsie kanitsutɨkamɨkɨ Tsini makumawetsie, 'Erumi kwieya mata'atɨkatsie. Tau manatineikatsieta, Haramara Mɨmɨki mayema manuyeniere tahetɨa manuye'axe mana katinawiyakamɨkɨ.
Manata mɨyeyani xekwie manuye'atɨkani, tau makayuyuipike hepatsie, Terɨkaxi mematihetsie wahepa, makumawe Tsini kaniuyeyeimɨkɨ Karetsi-Waxineya paitɨ, Katsaxi-'araxi meta 'Atsimuni kaniye'atɨkaimɨkɨ.
Manata 'Ekipitu 'akiyaritsie kaneukayunimɨkɨ haramara Meritexaniyu mata'atɨka mɨye'anikɨ.
»Kwie manuye'atɨkani tau makayuyuipike hepatsie mieme haramara mata'atɨka tetsita kaniuye'atɨkaimɨkɨ.
»Kwie manuye'atɨkani tayeta manuye'atɨkatsie haramaratsie heukawetɨ hɨri 'Uxi mɨtitewatsie,
manata 'Uxi mɨyeyani Rewu Kamati paitɨ. Manata mɨyeyani Tserari kaniye'amɨkɨ,
manata mɨyeyani Tsipuruni paitɨ, Katsaxi-'Enahani mɨrakutewatsie kaniuye'amɨkɨ. Xekwie manuye'atɨka mɨkɨ kanayeimɨkɨ tayeta muyekatsie.
»Xekwie manuye'atɨkani tau manatineika hepatsie mieme, Katsaxi-'Enahani kanitsutɨamɨkɨ, Tsepani mɨrakutewatsie kaniukayeimɨkɨ.
Tsepani mɨyeyani Xiwɨra kaneukayunimɨkɨ, 'Ahini tserieta mukuma, mana mɨyeyani tau manatineika kaneutayunimɨkɨ harakuna Kinereti tetsitayaritsie ye'anike,
manata Kurutani hatuxameyari 'utɨma kaneukayunimɨkɨ, Haramara Mɨmɨki mɨtitewatsie kaniye'amɨkɨ. »Mɨkɨ naukatɨ xekwieyari manuye'atɨka kanayeimɨkɨ».
Muitsexi 'ixaheritsixi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'aitɨani: «'Ikɨ kwie kanihɨkɨtɨni xeyu'iwatɨwetɨ xemitawiya. Yawé mɨpaɨ kanaineni 'atanauka heimana 'imeriyu nuiwari xeikɨa mekanitawiyakuni,
Xuweni meta Kahari, metatsiere Manatsexi nuiwarimama hixɨata me'atɨ yukwie memu'axixɨkɨri.
'Ikɨ huta nuiwariyari heimana 'imeriyu yukwie mekanexeiyakaitɨni tau manatineika hepatsie, haa Kurutani manuyehane 'aurie, Keriku 'anutauye, tau manatineika hepa».
Kwie kememɨteyetuiriyarie
Yawé Muitsexi mɨpaɨ katiniutahɨawe:
«'Ikɨ teɨteri kwie memɨyetuani mekanihɨkɨtɨni wakwie mayanikɨ: mawari wewiwame 'Eriyatsaxi meta Kutsuhexi Nuni nu'aya.
Xemeta, xeime xekanitahɨawikuni yunuiwaritsie, mɨxeparewienikɨ kwie mɨxeyetuirienikɨ».
Kememɨtetetewakai memanuyetekai nuiwaritsie:
Karewi Kepune nu'aya, Kura nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
Tsamuheri 'Amihuri nu'aya, Tsimehuni nuiwarimamatsie.
'Erirari Kitsiruni nu'aya, Wenikamini nuiwarimamatsie,
Wukihi Kukiri nu'aya, Rani nuiwarimamatsie,
Kaniheri 'Epuri nu'aya, hixɨapa memɨ'axe Manatsexi Kutse nu'aya nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme.
Kemuheri Tsipitani nu'aya, manuyeka 'Epɨrahini Kutse nu'aya nuiwarimama wahetsie,
'Eritsapani Parinaki nu'aya, manuyeka Tsawuruni nuiwarimama wahetsie,
Paritiheri 'Atsani nu'aya, manuyeka 'Itsakaxi nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
'Akihuri Tserumi nu'aya, manuyeka 'Atsexi nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme,
Peraheri 'Amihuri nu'aya, manuyeka Nepɨtahari nuiwarimama wahetsiemieme.
Yawé 'ikɨ kaniwaruhɨritɨani kwie 'ixaheritsixi memɨwayetuirienikɨ, Kanani kwieyaritsie.
